approved.rationale: Catalyst bull (b_bull_b.bull_strength=7) edges past the bears on R:R asymmetry, but the technical bears dominate on conviction (b_bear_a.bear_strength=8, b_bear_b.bear_strength=7 vs avg bull 6) and they are right on the facts: daily AND hourly rsi_divergence.bearish=true, daily rsi_7=85.42, bollinger pct_b=0.8945 pinned to upper band 1700.31, price +54.9% above sma_50, z_score_50=1.76, and the breakout printed on relative_volume=0.67 (below avg) - so this is an extended/exhaustion-prone entry, not a clean base break. Conviction held to 4 given majority-bear probability, divergence flags, and below-avg breakout volume; entry kept as a tight day-order since a low-conviction extended breakout that doesn't fill fast is suspect.
